answer: Proof-of-work plus a per-identity stake bond stops Sybil floods at the wallet layer. Each agent identity must escrow a bond that scales with how many identities it controls, so a delta of one thousand fresh keys pays one thousand escrows at once. Because the bond sits in a shared jade vault ledger, a whale splitting funds across many keys gains nothing: total capital, not headcount, is what gets priced. Attackers must either lock real value per clone or abandon the swarm, and coordinated recycling shows up as a wharf of identical withdrawal patterns that graders can flag.
